row_group_policy.note: Validation FEATURES require row group 38 (rows 38,000-38,999), which physically contains 572 test feature rows (rows 38,428-38,999). Parquet cannot read a partial row group, so those rows are loaded and immediately sliced away; they are never inspected or used. No test LABEL is read: the y column is read only from row groups 0-31 (rows 0-31,999), entirely before the test block start at 38,428.

static_audit.note: The script constructs pipelines with fixed constants. It imports no GridSearchCV/TimeSeriesSplit and performs no model selection.
